story: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet so its dots AI agents can buy things for users
source_line: Sources: OpenAI Developer Community, TechCrunch, 9to5Mac, The Paypers

segments.label: THIS WEEK IN AI
segments.title: ChatGPT can now shop for you
segments.narration: ChatGPT can now shop for you without ever seeing your card number.

segments.label: WHAT HAPPENED
segments.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet
segments.narration: OpenAI began rolling out ChatGPT Wallet on November thirteenth. Its dots agents can buy for you.

segments.label: HOW IT WORKS
segments.title: You approve every purchase
segments.narration: You approve items, total and card with Face ID or a fingerprint. A payment token hides your real card.

segments.label: WHAT IT MEANS FOR YOU
segments.title: The catch: limited access
segments.narration: The catch: it starts with US ChatGPT Pro subscribers, and sites blocking AI agents may fail.

segments.label: OUR TAKE
segments.title: Don't block verified agents
segments.narration: Our take: if you sell online, don't block verified agents.
